system_readback: Gaming packaging and swap-test guidance remain Theory and unmeasured. The pixel battery measures brightness, contrast, colour and edge density; it cannot certify depicted faces, focal composition, motivation or a causal click-through effect.
application: Use accessible human objectives, one clear information gap, blue-sky spectacle, strong foreground identity and five distinct composition families per episode. Compare exact race/car-reward and secret-room source packages while retaining below-threshold precedents as such.
performance_snapshot: Retained October 5 public catalogue scores, not refreshed performance or private CTR/retention.

official_facts.finding: As checked October 14, official release is November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
Publisher describes a single-player experience. Shared story co-op has not been established by these sources; plan parallel saves/relay team strategy.
